finding.summary: The amended live results have no execution-time CWD, imported-module path, or source digest. The amendment declares python_source_sha256 1e6d1aa5..., but the documented canonical digest of all Python files at its clean b158 revision is abb70f1b..., so that aggregate pin is not independently reproducible from the stated source contract.
